Commentary.Commentary: KL Rahul collects the series-win trophy and the victorious Indian team poses for a team photo as well. That is it then from this game and from India's tour of Bangladesh as well. The hosts won the ODI series 2-1 and it is the visitors who have swept away the Test series 2-0 and kept their 2nd place in the World Test Championship Points table. Both teams are done for the year 2022 and India will now welcome Sri Lanka for a T20I and ODI series that will start on January 3, 2023. As for Bangladesh, they have a bit of a break before they return to international action. Hope you enjoyed our coverage and wish you and your family a Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year in advance. Until next time, take care and goodbye!

The Indian captain, KL Rahul says that when you play so much cricket together it is about trusting the guys in the middle. Adds that there is always a belief that someone will put their hand up and get the job done for the team. Shares that it is human nature to be nervous in situations like these. Feels that Ravichandran Ashwin and Shreyas Iyer showed a lot of composure on a tough wicket and played it with ease to get India the victory. Shares that they knew it was going to be difficult and they would need to grind on this wicket and work hard for runs. Feels that new ball does a lot more and it is about who plays the new ball well. Also says that it is about cashing in ocne the ball gets old. Says that will learn from this experience and get better as individuals. Feels that the depth in the fast bowling department has been good over the last 6-7 years and it showed in this Test with Mohammed Siraj, Umesh Yadav and Jaydev Unadkat delivering for the side. Ends by saying that Ashwin and Axar Patel too chipped in to bundle Bangladesh out.

Cheteshwar Pujara is the PLAYER OF THE SERIES for his sensational batting in both innings of the first Test match. He says that it was a very competitive series. Shares that he had put in a lot of hard work by working on his game and playing first-class games. Adds that that is important to be in touch by playing first-class games. Feels that is important to win each and every Test considering the World Test Championship. Also says that is important to be on top of the game. Ends by saying that ups and downs are a part of a cricketer's journey and it is all about being mentally strong and bouncing back.

Ravichandran Ashwin is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH for his brilliant contribution with both bat and the ball. Ashwin says that the game was on the line and there wasn't much batting left so is happy to have done the job. Adds that Bangladesh played well and put them under pressure but applauds Shreyas Iyer for the way he played and they got over the line. Mentions that they would have liked to play more shots but the bowling was good and they needed to trust their defense a bit more as well. Adds that the pitch was good, it was a bit slow but the ball got softer after 30 or so overs and the same ball could have been played off the front foot as well as the back foot. Ends by saying that barring the first innings in Chattogram, Bangladesh played really well and it was a well-contested series.

Shakib Al Hasan, the skipper of Bangladesh, says that everyone contributed in this game. Adds that at Mirpur they always have a chance. Feels that they put on a good show and it was what the crowd wanted with both sides playing very good Test cricket. Credits Shreyas Iyer and Ravichandran Ashwin with the way they batted and feels that they absorbed pressure well. Shares that it is his job to contribute with both bat and ball and it was unfortunate that he could not bowl in the first Test. Reckons that they needed one more wicket to get into the tail of India. Shares that he is happy with the way they fought. Ends by saying that they can only improve from hereon.
The presentation ceremony...

Earlier in the game, Shakib Al Hasan won the toss and opted to bat first on a track that had loads of grass on it but it wasn't live grass. The Bangladeshi batters all got off to starts in the first innings but no one apart from Mominul Haque could convert those starts. For India, Umesh Yadav and Ravichandran Ashwin starred with the ball as both of them picked up four wickets each. The Indian top-order faltered and it was a big 150-plus stand between Shreyas Iyer and Rishabh Pant that gave India a sizeable first-innings lead. Shakib Al Hasan and Taijul Islam also got four wickets each. The hosts were in a lot of trouble in their second innings but a fighting half-century from Zakir Hasan and a couple of quickfire knocks from Litton Das and Nurul Hasan gave them a final lead of 144 runs. The target wasn't a big one but it was a tricky wicket and the hosts gave it their all but the experience of Ravichandran Ashwin shone through as he took India to victory.

'The one that got away' - this is what Bangladesh will feel about this game. They were under the caush throughout the first couple of days but came roaring back on Day 3 with some scintillating batting and then magical bowling as well. Their spinners had their tail up coming into Day 4 and neither Shakib Al Hasan nor Mehidy Hasan disappoint. Mehidy went on to pick up a famous five-for but once Iyer and Ashwin started to consolidate, the Bangladeshi spinners lost their line and lengths. With not many runs to play with, too many boundary balls were bowled and India didn't let them off the hook. In the end, Bangladesh had no answer to the depth in India's batting and their batters just didn't put up enough runs on the board for them to get the win.

It was a fairly even contest coming into Day 4 but Bangladesh did have the upper hand and they become the favorites to win the game when Mehidy Hasan and Shakib Al Hasan picked up three quick wickets early in the day. India had their backs against the wall but have managed to turn misery into joy. Jaydev Unadkat was the first to fall on Day 4 and then Axar Patel and Rishabh Pant both fell in quick succession. With still 71 needed to win and the Bangladeshi spinners on top of proceedings, Shreyas Iyer and Ravichandran Ashwin stitched together an unbeaten partnership with the latter going on to end things with a flurry of boundaries toward the end. A remarkable win for the visitors and they will return home jubilant.

What a game! What a ripper of a contest we have witnessed in Mirpur! It is a Christmas Miracle as India have recovered from being 74 for 7 down to going on to win the game. Shreyas Iyer and Ravichandran Ashwin, take a bow. But spare a thought for Bangladesh and especially Mehidy Hasan who gave it his all and even picked up a five-wicket haul only to end up on the losing side. India seal the series 2-0 and keep their unbeaten record against Bangladesh is Test matches intact.

FOUR! Ravichandran Ashwin finishes things off for India! Short and on middle by Mehidy Hasan, Ravichandran Ashwin picks the length early and pulls this one right between mid-wicket and mid on. Gets enough bat on it and it goes for a boundary. India win by 3 wickets and win the series 2-0!
FOUR! Tossed up, on a length on off by Mehidy Hasan, Ravichandran Ashwin gets to the pitch of the ball and lofts this one over mid off and collects a boundary. Just 4 needed now for India.
On a length on middle, Ravichandran Ashwin defends this one on the leg side.
Fuller on off, Ravichandran Ashwin gets forward and defends this one down the wicket.

On a length around off, Ravichandran Ashwin defends this one from the front foot but gets a thick outside edge that flies past first slip. Litton Das performs the chase as the batters run two in the process.

SIX! Ravichandran Ashwin greets Mehidy Hasan with a maximum! Mehidy Hasan misses his length and bowls this one short and on middle, the ball does not bounce as expected but Ravichandran Ashwin still goes through with the pull. Clears the deep mid-wicket fence and collects a maximum.
Short and on leg, Ravichandran Ashwin goes back and whips this one uppishly towards deep mid-wicket for a single. India are now 16 runs away.

Fuller and on off by Shakib Al Hasan, Ravichandran Ashwin pushes this one towards mid off and sets off for a single. Najmul Hossain Shanto there takes his eyes off the ball as he went down to collect and concedes the second run.
Tad short on off, Ravichandran Ashwin punches this one towards cover for a dot.
Length delivery outside off, Ravichandran Ashwin leaves it alone.
On a length around off, Shreyas Iyer gets forward and drives it down to long off for a single.
Tossed up, fuller and on middle, Shreyas Iyer looks to drive this one on the off side but gets it from the inner part of the bat back to the bowler.
Back of a length and angling in on middle, Ravichandran Ashwin defends this one towards point for a dot.

On a length on middle, Ravichandran Ashwin looks to defend this one from the crease but the ball keeps low and he somehow manages to get his bat down on time. The ball comes off the bottom part of the bat and goes on the bounce behind the wicket.
Full around off, Ravichandran Ashwin gets hurried and can only drive this one to cover for a dot.
Short of a length outside off by Khaled Ahmed, Ravichandran Ashwin punches this one along the ground to the right of deep point and collects a couple of runs.
Good-length delivery in the channel outside off, Shreyas Iyer taps this one towards point and takes a single.
Short and at the batter by Khaled Ahmed, Ravichandran Ashwin stands tall and pulls this one towards deep square leg for a single.
On a length and around off, eased away in front of cover-point for a single.

Flatter delivery around off, Ravichandran Ashwin punches it off the back foot and straight into the pads of the man at silly point. The ball almost ricochets onto the stumps and Ashwin was momentarily out of his crease.
Tossed up on off stump, Ashwin pushes it out toward silly mid off.
Shorter length, turning away from leg stump, Ashwin watchfully nudges it down toward short mid-wicket.
Flighted delivery, on off stump, Ashwin blocks it off the front foot.
Taijul Islam comes back into the attack and starts with a short one around off. Shreyas Iyer punches it off the back foot and down to wide long off for an easy single.
Good length, around the top of off, and solidly kept out by Ashwin.

EDGED AND FOUR! A stroke of luck here for Ravichandran Ashwin but he will take it. Good length in that channel around off, Ashwin looks to drive but gets a thick outside edge that flies inside the diving man at gully and into the fence. Khaled Ahmed cannot believe his luck and India need 26 more runs to win.
Hard length around off and middle, Ashwin defends it out.
FOUR! Wrong line and four easy runs for Ravichandran Ashwin. Length ball angling down leg, Ashwin just flicks it away into the fine leg fence.
Goes full now and angles it into the off stump. The ball keeps a bit low and Ashwin gets an inside edge onto the pads as he looks to block.
Khaled Ahmed comes on to bowl for the first time in this innings. He starts off with a good-length delivery, seaming away from leg stump. Ravichandran Ashwin awkwardly fends it away.
Flighted, on off stump, kept out by Iyer with ease.
Full and on off stump, Shreyas Iyer blocks it off the front foot.
This is attacking the stumps, Iyer blocks it out.
FOUR! Poor bowling and Shreyas Iyer is playing a match-winning knock here. Short and wide, slapped away off the back foot through the cover region for a boundary. Nelson comes up for India.
Flighted delivery, on a nagging length and around off, Ravichandran Ashwin squeezes it out on the off side for a quick single.
This is floated up on middle, Ashwin defends it off the front foot.

FOUR! Drops it a bit short and Shreyas Iyer latches onto it. This is over off stump and Iyer just rocks back before pulling it well in front of mid-wicket for another boundary. India are now 39 runs away.
Flatter delivery around middle, Iyer just defends it out.
FOUR! Up and over! Tossed up around off, Shreyas Iyer comes down the track and lofts it over the fielder at mid off to pick up a crucial boundary.
Shakib holds it back a touch and bowls it outside off. The ball turns away and Ashwin ends up pushing at it. The ball goes off the outer half and past point as they pick up a single.
Tossed up full and on the stumps, Ashwin pushes it out.
Shakib Al Hasan bowls this one on a length and drifting onto the pads, Ravichandran Ashwin goes back and clips this one to the left of deep square leg for a couple of runs.
On a length around off, Shreyas Iyer pushes this one to mid-wicket for a dot.
Length delivery at the pads, Ravichandran Ashwin clips this one to deep square leg for a single. 50 needed now to win.
Full on off from round the wicket, Ravichandran Ashwin drives this one to the left of mid-wicket but cannot get it past Zakir Hasan.
Tad short and turning into the batter, Ravichandran Ashwin goes back and pushes it to mid-wicket.
Full outside off and turning in, Ravichandran Ashwin blocks it out on the off side.
Full on middle by Mehidy Hasan, Ravichandran Ashwin looks to clip this one but gets an inside edge back onto the pads.
Tossed up, full on off, Shreyas Iyer pushes this one back to Shakib Al Hasan.
On a length on middle, Shreyas Iyer knocks this one towards cover for a dot.
On a length and drifting onto the pads, Shreyas Iyer clips this one on the bounce to Mominul Haque at short leg who makes a good stop.
On a length around off, Ravichandran Ashwin drives this one towards deep cover for a single.
Short and on off, turning away, Ravichandran Ashwin pushes this one to mid-wicket for a dot.
Full and quicker on middle, Ravichandran Ashwin blocks this one out for a dot.
Fuller on off, keeps a bit low but Shreyas Iyer is up to the task and defends this one down the wicket.
On a length on off, Shreyas Iyer taps this one back to the bowler.
FOUR! Nicely played! Mehidy Hasan floats this one full around off, Shreyas Iyer plants his foot forward  and drives this one against the spin. Gets it past point for a boundary.
Short and on middle, turning into the batter, Ravichandran Ashwin goes back and clips this towards deep square leg for a single.
Fuller on off, Ravichandran Ashwin pushes this one back to the bowler.
On a length around off, Ravichandran Ashwin gets forward and blocks it out to the left of the bowler.

Drinks break! A fascinating first hour of play on Day 4 and Bangladesh have uprooted three early wickets in the session. The equation now stands at 57 runs to win for India and 3 wickets to be taken for the hosts to get a famous victory. Shreyas Iyer and Ravichandran Ashwin are currently on the crease and all of India's hopes and pinned on this pair. Bangladesh will want to get rid of one of them at the earliest. The next hour or so is going to be an exciting ride.
Flighted, full and on middle by Taijul Islam, Shreyas Iyer defends this one with a straight bat back to the bowler.
Short and on off, Ravichandran Ashwin goes back and punches this one towards deep cover for a single.
Taijul Islam fires this one on a length and at the pads, Shreyas Iyer pushes this one towards mid-wicket for a single.
Touch fuller on off, Shreyas Iyer gets forward and plays this one back to the bowler.
On a length on middle, Shreyas Iyer knocks this one back to the bowler.
Full on middle by Taijul Islam, Shreyas Iyer defends this one to cover and wants a single but gets sent back by Ravichandran Ashwin.
Short and outside off, Shreyas Iyer punches this down to long off for a single.
Full on middle, Ravichandran Ashwin advances down the track to push this one on the off side but gets an inside edge towards square leg for a single.
On a length outside off, Shreyas Iyer works this fine towards short third man for a single.
On a length outside off, Shreyas Iyer looks to work this one on the leg side and closes the bat face early. Gets a leading edge that falls short of cover.
Tossed up, full on off, Shreyas Iyer gets forward and defends it back to the bowler.
Short around off, Shreyas Iyer goes back and pushes this one to mid-wicket.
Quicker and flatter, around middle, Ashwin stays deep in his crease and blocks it out.
This is tossed up, Ravichandran Ashwin looks to come down the pitch and hit his way out of trouble but mistimes it toward mid on.
Keeps it around the off stump and Shreyas Iyer just strokes it through the cover region for a run.
Floated up around off, Iyer pushes it toward cover.
Shorter one around off, Ashwin punches it through cover for a single.

Swing and a miss! Taijul Islam comes back into the attack and tosses it up on off stump. Ravichandran Ashwin goes for the big heave across the line but the ball turns away sharply and Ashwin is beaten all ends up.
Flatter delivery around the pads, Iyer blocks it out.

BYE! Wow, how close was that to the leg stump? This is tossed up full and on the pads, Ravichandran Ashwin shuffles right across the off stump and looks to get inside the line of the ball in order to play the paddle sweep. Ashwin misses and the ball misses the leg stumps by a couple of inches before eluding the keeper. They cross for a bye.

DROPPED! Mominul Haque has been sensational at short leg but he has let go of a relatively easy chance. Nicely flighted around middle and leg, Ravichandran Ashwin nudges it to the left of Mominul and it is at a comfortable height as well. Mominul looks to grab it but ends up snatching at it and Mehidy Hasan seems disappointed. How costly will this miss prove to be?
Similar to the previous delivery but the length is pulled back ever so slightly, Ashwin manages to keep it out.
This is drifted in from around the off stump, Ravichandran Ashwin puts a big stride forward to defend.
This is tossed up wide of the off stump, Shreyas Iyer has to reach out for it and pushes it through the cover region for a single.
Shakib tries to slide this one into the pads but the ball angles down the leg side.
Bowled with a bit of a round-arm action and angled in very full at the toes, Ravichandran Ashwin blocks it out.
Floated up, on a length and around middle, Ashwin nudges it out on the leg side.
Bowls it slower and drops it short outside off, Shreyas Iyer rocks back and cuts it toward sweeper cover to turn the strike over.
Flighted delivery, around off and Iyer pushes it toward cover-point.
Drifted into the stumps and turning away from the right-hander, Iyer plays it late and with soft hands onto the off side.
Tosses it up again, full and outside off. Shreyas Iyer presses forward and plays it square of the wicket on the off side for one.
Tossed up on middle, Shreyas Iyer drives it gently towards silly mid on.
Around off, this is pushed away toward cover for an easy single.
A bit of yes and no but no harm is done. Flatter one around off, Ashwin pushes it out in front of the man at cover and looks for the single but Iyer sends him back and rightly so.
On a length and around off, a bit of turn and bounce on offer as well. Ashwin defends it down on the deck.
A touch shorter and turning in from outside off, Shreyas Iyer punches it towards the vacant short cover region and scampers through for a run.
Nicely drifted in on a nagging length and into middle. This one keeps a bit low and Ravichandran Ashwin does well to block it off the back foot.
On a length and around middle, Shreyas Iyer knocks it down to long on and picks up a single.
Shakib fires it in around off stump, Iyer stays solid in defense.
This is tossed up on the stumps, Shreyas Iyer blocks it out.
Shorter length around middle, Shreyas Iyer flicks off the back foot and Mominul Haque makes a sharp stop down to his right at short leg.
Nicely floated up, full and on middle and leg. Shreyas Iyer makes a bit of room and pushes it to the left of the bowler.

Mehidy Hasan bowls this one on a length outside off, Ravichandran Ashwin looks to work this one on the off side. Mehidy Hasan thinks he heard a noise and wants Shakib Al Hasan to go for a review but the Bangladesh skipper decides not to send it upstairs.
Full around off, Ravichandran Ashwin gets forward and defends this one towards silly mid off.
Fuller on middle, Ravichandran Ashwin pushes this one back to the bowler.
Ravichandran Ashwin walks in with India in a heap of trouble.

OUT! TIMBER! Another one bites the dust! Mehidy Hasan bowls this one on a length and drifting into the batter, Axar Patel goes back to work it on the leg side but fails to get any bat on it. The ball comes off his pads and takes the leg stump to send India into more trouble. Axar departs after a fighting knock and Mehidy Hasan picks up a stellar five-wicket haul. 71 runs are still needed for India to win with just 3 wickets in hand.
Full on middle, Axar Patel defends this one towards cover for a dot.
Beauty! Mehidy Hasan bowls this one on a length on off, turns away after pitching and beats Axar Patel on the outside edge as he looked to defend.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Shreyas Iyer looks to defend but the ball comes off the inner part of the bat towards short leg for a dot.
Full around off, Axar Patel pushes this one down to long on for a single.
Fuller on middle, Axar Patel knocks this one towards mid-wicket for a dot.
Full and on middle, Shreyas Iyer drives this one nicely towards deep cover. Gets off the mark with a single.
On a length and angling down the leg side, Shreyas Iyer looks to clip this one but misses.
Slower and short outside off by Shakib Al Hasan, Axar Patel rocks back and cuts this one towards deep backward point for a single.
Shreyas Iyer is the new man in.

OUT! LBW! Mehidy Hasan gets the big fish! Mehidy Hasan bowls this one on a length on middle, the ball drifts with the angle and Rishabh Pant ends up playing down the wrong line as he tried to defend. The ball strikes him in front of the stumps and the umpire raises the dreaded finger. Rishabh Pant discusses with Axar Patel and decides not to review and rightly so as the replays show that the ball was crashing into leg stump. 74 runs are still needed with 4 wickets in hand.
Mehidy Hasan fires this one full and on middle, Rishabh Pant defends this one towards cover for a dot.
Flighted, on a length on middle, Rishabh Pant advances down the track to work it on the leg sid but gets a leading edge towards point for a dot.
Full and on middle, Axar Patel gets forward and drives this one down to long off for a single.
Touch fuller on middle and turning away, Axar Patel defends this one towards point for a dot.
On a length and down the leg side, Axar Patel looks to work this one fine on the leg side but misses. The ball comes off his pads towards short fine leg for a dot.
Length delivery on middle, Rishabh Pant can only push this one back to the bowler.
On a length on off, Rishabh Pant uses his feet to get to the pitch of the ball but the ball comes off his pads and back to the bowler for a dot.
Fullish outside off by Shakib Al Hasan, Rishabh Pant gets inside and sweeps this one towards fine leg and collects a couple of runs.
Quicker and shorter on middle, Rishabh Pant defends this one back to the bowler.
On a length outside off, Rishabh Pant defens this one towards extra cover for a dot.
FOUR! Shakib Al Hasan tosses this one on a length around off, Rishabh Pant brings out the reverse sweep and hits this one through short third man for a boundary.
On a length around leg, Axar Patel goes back to defend but the ball keeps low and hits him low on the pads. A loud appeal but it was going down the leg side.

FOUR! Short and punished by Axar Patel! Short and on middle by Mehidy Hasan, Axar Patel picks the length early and rocks back to pull this one through mid-wicket. Collects a boundary to get into the 30s.
Full and on middle, Rishabh Pant uses his feet and pushes it down to long on for a single.
On a length outside off and turning away, Axar Patel cuts this one to deep cover for a single.
Full around off, Rishabh Pant drives this one towards deep cover for a single.
Flighted, on a length on middle, Rishabh Pant shimmies down the track and pushes it back to the bowler.
Full outside off, Axar Patel plants his foot forward and defends this one to cover for a dot.
Short and on off by Shakib Al Hasan, Rishabh Pant stays in the crease and clips this one towards deep square leg. Gets off the mark with a single.
Rishabh Pant is the new man in. A backward and forward short leg have been kept in place.

OUT! LBW! Shakib Al Hasan strikes in his first over of the day! Shakib Al Hasan bowls this one quicker and touch fuller on off, Jaydev Unadkat goes back to punch this one and pays the price as he gets caught plumb in front of the stumps. After a word with Axar Patel, he decides to review. The UltraEdge shows no bat and it is three reds on BallTracking. Jaydev Unadkat has to depart and India lose their review.
Leg bye! On a length around leg and turning in, Axar Patel looks to fend this one but the ball comes off his pads towards short fine leg for a single.
Short and on middle by Shakib Al Hasan, Jaydev Unadkat goes back and punches it to cover for a single.
Flighted, fuller around off, Jaydev Unadkat gets forward and defends it to cover.
Shakib Al Hasan to operate from the other end.
Length delivery on middle, Axar Patel pushes this one back to the bowler.
On a length around middle, Jaydev Unadkat sweeps this one down towards square leg for a single.
SIX! BANG! Full and on off by Mehidy Hasan, Jaydev Unadkat gets down on one knee and slog sweeps this one towards deep mid-wicket. Clears the fence with ease and collects a maximum.

Mehidy Hasan fires this one quicker, full and on middle, Jaydev Unadkat looks to defend this one and gets rapped on the pads. A loud appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Shakib Al Hasan decides to send it upstairs. The UltraEdge shows that it was pad first but on BallTracking it is umpire's call as it was clipping the leg stump and so the onfield decision stands.
Full on middle by Mehidy Hasan, Jaydev Unadkat rolls his wrist and executes the sweep to perfection. A fumble at short fine leg allows the batters to run two there.
Mehidy Hasan starts with a length delivery at the pads, Jaydev Unadkat gets forward to defend, the ball comes off his gloves and falls just short of Litton Das at first slip.

We are all set for the play to commence on Day 4! The umpires walk out to the middle as the Bangladeshi players can be seen raring to go around the boundary ropes. The overnight batters for India, Jaydev Unadkat and Axar Patel stride out to the middle as well and it will be the former who will face the first delivery of the day. Mehidy Hasan, the star with the ball on Day 3 will start proceedings on Day 4. Let's play...

India's top-order woes continued in the big games as all went out for cheap scores and neither of them for once looked settled on the crease. Axar Patel has been their best batter so far but with the likes of Rishabh Pant, Shreyas Iyer and Ravichandran Ashwin still to come, India will feel that if they capitalise on the bad deliveries then 100 runs can be wiped out in no time. Will they be able to do it though on a pitch that now has more than a few demons in it? We shall find out soon as the first session is coming up soon.

We had pretty exciting cricket on Days 1 and 2 of the game but the best action was reserved for Day 3 as both teams kept on fighting tooth and nail, leaving the game hanging on a knife edge. Bangladesh do have a slight advantage as they have sent the Indian top 4 packing and will know that a couple of early wickets here and the game can be won.

Hello and welcome ladies and gentlemen to Day 4 of the 2nd and final Test match between Bangladesh and India at the Sher-e-Bangla Stadium in Mirpur. What a fascinating contest we have on our hands as the hosts need 6 wickets to win and the visitors need 100 runs. Which team will reign supreme here?
... DAY 4, SESSION 1 ...

Right then, we have had 3 exciting days of Test cricket and after those three days, we can't pick a winner. It looked to be India's game all the way but the hosts have come roaring back and have a real chance of leveling the series here. 100 runs are needed for India to win with 6 wickets in hand and a couple of in-form batters yet to come. Bangladesh will pray that their spin trio comes good and does the job for them. Whatever the result may be, we will surely get a lot of entertainment. Day 4 will begin on Sunday at 9 am IST (3.30 am GMT) but you can join us for the early build-up as usual. Cheers!

The man of the moment, Mehidy Hasan is in for a quick chat. He says that he is happy with his spell. Adds that the wicket is turning well and it is all about hitting the right lengths. Says that they will try to get early wickets tomorrow and Virat Kohli's wicket was an important one. Ends by saying that they need to improve their bowling and do well.

India had the game in the palm of their hands until the second session on Day 3 began but since then, they seemed to have let go of their advantage. They did manage to clean up Bangladesh but did concede at least 50 runs more than they should have as they had the hosts on the ropes at one point. This could prove to be costly as their top order has failed miserably yet again. The skipper, KL Rahul was the first to go and then both Cheteshwar Pujara and Shubman Gill tried to use their feet to counter the spin but were stumped. Virat Kohli occupied the crease without showing much intent and was ultimately dismissed. The only positive with the bat has been Axar Patel who has mustered up important runs for his side. The good thing for India is that the in-form batter, Rishabh Pant and Shreyas Iyer are yet to come but it will be an uphill task when they come out to bat on Day 4.

Bangladesh got bundled out after a few spirited performances with the bat for 231 runs and had 144 runs to play with. They needed wickets in the final session to have a shot at glory and boy, they have dominated with the ball here. Right from the very first ball that Shakib Al Hasan bowled, Bangladesh knew they will get opportunities. Shakib did get a wicket early in the innings and that set the tone. Shakib and Taijul Islam continued to create chances but it was Mehidy Hasan who proved to be the difference-maker as he picked up three wickets for just 12 runs, sending back 3 big guns for India in the process. The hosts have all the momentum going into the fourth day and will look to make early inroads in order to put the opposition under even more pressure.

Wow, what a day of Test cricket have just witnessed! Well, they don't call Day 3 the moving day for nothing. A total of 14 wickets fell throughout the course of the day and in the end, the pendulum did swing in favour of the hosts who will now believe that they can pull off the upset. India still need 100 more runs to win but have lost their top four batters which might play a huge role in the outcome.
FOUR! Slightly shorter and on off, Axar Patel rocks back and punches it past extra covers for a boundary! That will be STUMPS on Day 3.
Goes fuller again, and on off. Axar Patel knocks it to mid off again.
Fuller and on off, Axar Patel defends it to the man at mid off.
Bowls it outside off again, Axar Patel reads it well and lets it go.
Another one outside off, Axar Patel defends it with his pads as the ball lobs towards slips. Dot.
Turning it in from outside off, Axar Patel defends it back towards the bowler.
This one lands on off as well, Axar Patel punches it to extra covers for a single. He keeps his strike for the next over.
Fuller and on off, Axar Patel taps it to short covers.
Bowls it on off, Axar Patel lunges and blocks it solidly.
Tossed up again and outside off, Jaydev Unadkat strokes it away through covers for a single.
Floated up around off, Jaydev Unadkat pushes it towards cover-point.
Fuller and around off, Jaydev Unadkat blocks it out.
Slows it up now and pulls the length back as well. Axar Patel looks to block off the back foot but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Tossed up, full and outside off, turning in. Axar Patel keeps it out.
This is around off, Jaydev Unadkat pushes it through the cover region for a single.
Another fuller one as this is again defended towards the bowler.
This one lands on leg, Jaydev Unadkat defends it back towards the bowler.
Quicker and on off, Jaydev Unadkat defends it solidly.
Fuller and on off, Jaydev Unadkat taps it to covers for one.
Jaydev Unadkat has been sent in as the nightwatchman.

OUT! TAKEN! An excellent catch by Mominul Haque and Virat Kohli departs for just a run! Full and outside the off stump forcing Kohli to lean forward to play this. He looks to defend it but gets an inside edge off the pads towards short leg and Mominul Haque takes a sharp catch diving to his left. India are in a lot of trouble now as they lose four wickets in quick succession and they still 108 runs to win.
Commentary.Howout: c Mominul Haque b Mehidy Hasan

Commentary.Commentary: Full and on off, Virat Kohli flicks it straight to the man at square leg.
Bowls it on middle and leg, Axar Patel eases it to the man at mid-wicket for one.
Fuller and outside off, Axar Patel looks to block it but misses.
FOUR! Errs in line and gets punished. Slightly shorter and on off, Axar Patel drills it through mid-wicket for a boundary!
Fuller and outside off, Virat Kohli lunges and blocks it away.
Fuller and on middle, Virat Kohli blocks it and gets an inside edge towards square leg. Dot.
This one lands on off as well, Virat Kohli reads it well and blocks it out.
Bowls it on off, Virat Kohli defends it to mid on.
Another fuller one, Virat Kohli taps it to the man at point.
Fuller and on off, Virat Kohli eases it to the man at short covers.
Bowls it outside off, Axar Patel blocks it to mid off. A maiden from Mehidy Hasan!
Fuller on the stumps, Axar pushes it to the short cover fielder.
Bowls it on middle turning it in, Axar Patel eases it back towards the bowler.
Fuller on the stumps, Axar defends it to the short cover region.
Another fuller one as this is defended towards the man at mid off.
Bowls it fuller and on off, Axar Patel lunges and blocks it away.

Virat Kohli knew it hit the blade and lives to fight another day. This is flighted on a length and drifted in from around off stump. Kohli presses forward to defend but seems to have missed it as the ball raps him on the pads. Taijul Islam appeals loudly and after a long thought, the umpire raises the finger. It is reviewed instantaneously and UltraEdge shows that there was a faint inside edge on it.
Fuller and on off, Kohli taps it to the man at covers.
Bowls it on off, Kohli defends it solidly off the front foot.
Quicker one here, Kohli defends watchfully.
Fuller one this time, Kohli defends it away. Half an appeal as the pad was in front of the bat but the replays show that the ball did hit the bat.
Fuller and on off, Kohli defends it solidly off the front foot.
Turns it in from outside off, Patel defend it solidly off the front foot.
Shorter and outside off turning it away, Patel leaves it alone.
Fuller and on off, Kohli knocks it to mid on for one.
This one lands on off, Kohli eases it to the man at short covers.
Another fuller and on off, Kohli blocks it to short leg.
Fuller and outside off, Kohli looks to defend it but misses.

Holds it back a touch and pulls the length back as well. The ball is delivered around off stump, it turns in and bounces a bit extra as well. Axar Patel gets taken by surprise but manages to keep it out.
Tossed up on off stump, turning in, Axar Patel defends it down the pitch.
Taijul Islam switches to over the wicket and drifts it onto the pads. Axar Patel tickles it through short fine leg and picks up a couple of runs.
Tossed up around leg stump, Axar Patel plays it with soft hands and towards mid-wicket.
Nagging length on off stump, Axar Patel tentatively blocks it out.
Taijul Islam comes back into the attack and starts off with a fuller one on the pads, Axar Patel flicks it straight to square leg.
Mehidy Hasan pulls back the length and bowls it around off, Virat Kohli goes on the back foot to keep it out. A wicket-maiden then for Mehidy.
This is floated up on middle, Kohli reaches forward to defend.
Tossed up on off stump, Kohli keeps it out.

A tad shorter and turning in from around middle. Virat Kohli goes deep in his crease and flicks it right of the man at mid-wicket who makes a half-stop. Kohli denies the single on the misfield and rightly so.
Virat Kohli walks in.

OUT! STUMPED! Mehidy Hasan completely outfoxes Shubman Gill who walks back after a nervy inning. This is nicely flighted on a length and outside off. Gill looks to step out and get to the pitch of the ball but is beaten in the flight. Also, the ball doesn't turn in rather drifts away beating the outside edge. Nurul Hasan whips off the bails in a flash and Gill is well out of his crease. Mehidy Hasan gets his second wicket and India in a spot of bother here. 116 runs still needed with 7 wickets in hand.
Commentary.Howout: st Nurul Hasan b Mehidy Hasan

Commentary.Commentary: This is floated up outside off, Shubman Gill blocks it off the front foot.
Comes from around the wicket now and serves it on a length around off at 140 clicks. Axar Patel plays it toward point.
Goes a bit fuller and angles it across the off stump, Axar Patel shoulders arms at it.
Short again and around off, this is nicely punched away well in front of the square on the off side for a couple of runs.
Hits the length hard and bowls it around off, Axar Patel hops and keeps it out towards mid off.
Good length, angling across the left-hander and it is left alone for the keeper to correct.
Starts off a bit of a loosener. This is a fraction shorter and outside off, Axar Patel slaps it away wide of the man at the backward point fence and collects a couple of runs.
Taskin Ahmed comes into the attack now.
On off stump, this is driven down to long off for a single.
This is speared into middle and leg, Axar Patel gets hurried but manages to keep it out.
Drops it shorter on off and looks to turn it away, Axar Patel mistimes it off the back foot onto the leg side.
Looks to fire this one into middle and leg, Patel stays solid in defense.
Tossed up full on off stump, Axar Patel defends it off the front foot.
This is shorter and around off, Axar Patel backs away and plays it to short extra cover.
Tosses it up full and around leg stump, Shubman Gill comes down the pitch and pushes it to silly mid on.
Floated, full and at the toes, Axar Patel works it 'round the corner for one.
This is drifted onto middle and leg, Patel presses forward to defend.
This is tossed up on off stump and Axar Patel defends it out.
FOUR! Just a fraction shorter and Axar Patel pounces on it. This is bowled around off, Patel rocks back and punches it through covers for a boundary.
Quicker one, on a nagging length and around middle, Axar Patel goes deep in his crease to defend it out.
Nicely tossed up around middle, Shubman Gill watchfully defends it out.
Flighted delivery, Axar Patel uses his feet and drives it back past the bowler for a run.
Turn and bounce! Comes from around the wicket and bowls it on a length around off, the ball turns away square leaving Axar Patel completely bamboozled.
Fuller now and at the stumps, Shubman Gill knocks it down to long on for a single.
Turning in from around middle and Gill blocks it onto the leg side.
Big turn! Tossed up on a shorter length and around off. Shubman Gill comes down the track to block but gets undone by the turn and hit on the pads.
Flatter delivery on the pads, Axar Patel stays back and defends it on the leg side.
Tossed up around off, Shubman Gill uses his feet well and pushes it down to long off for a single.
This is flighted down leg, Axar Patel gets a fine tickle on it. The ball runs away towards the fine leg fence but Mehidy Hasan chases it down and saves a run for his side.
Drops it a bit short and around off, Shubman Gill steers it off the back foot and through point for a single.

Close again and Shubman Gill looks nevry out there. Shakib Al Hasan angles this one in on a nagging length and into the pads. Gill gets pushed onto the back foot and the ball keeps low as well. The ball hits the pads and seems to be going down leg as there is a stifled appeal from Bangladesh.
Tossed up around middle, Shubman Gill keeps it out.

A huge appeal for lbw and the bowler and keeper seem certain about it. The umpire remains unmoved and Shakib Al Hasan doesn't review it either. This is pushed through quicker and into off stump. Axar Patel strides out to defend but gets a faint inside edge onto the pads.
This one is angling into the pads, Axar Patel looks to block but gets it off the inside edge towards square leg.
Around off again and kept out by Axar Patel.
Almost skids through. Nagging length, around off and sliding in. Axar Patel looks to block off the front foot but gets a faint inside edge onto the pads.
This is fired in on off stump, Axar Patel keeps it out.
Axar Patel walks in.

OUT! STUMPED! Nurul Hasan with a brilliant recovery and all of a sudden, India are two down. Mehidy Hasan comes into the attack and gets a wicket off his very first delivery. Tosses it up on a shorter length and well outside off. Cheteshwar Pujara comes down the track but gets beaten in the flight. Pujara tries to adjust but gets an inside edge off the pads. Nurul Hasan just about manages to collect the ball and dislodges the bails. The third umpire checks it and finds that Pujara failed to get his bat down in time and has to walk back.
Commentary.Howout: st Nurul Hasan b Mehidy Hasan

Commentary.Commentary: A bit of a misfield and they get two. On a length and around middle, this is pushed away toward mid on for a quick single. Mushfiqur Rahim comes rushing in and overruns the ball and the batters get an additional run.
Floats it up now around middle, Gill defends it out.
Flatter delivery around middle and leg, tucked away to mid-wicket.
Shubman Gill steps out and looks to use his feet but Shakib fires it in at the toes. Gill ends up pushing it back to the bowler.
Nagging length, floated up around off, Shubman Gill goes on the back foot to keep it out.
A tad shorter and slower around off, Cheteshwar Pujara has enough time to rock back and punch it through cover for a run.
Maiden! This is pushed through on off stump, Shubman Gill blocks it out.
Flights it up now around middle but Gill stays solid in defense.
And again! Tossed up on off stump, Gill lunges forward to defend.
Fuller and on off stump, Gill defends it out off the front foot.
Gives it a bit more air and floats it around off, Gill pushes it out on the off side.
Nicely drifted onto middle and leg, Shubman Gill keeps it out off the front foot.
FOUR! This one lands down leg, Cheteshwar Pujara sweeps it through fine leg for a boundary!
Fuller and on off, Cheteshwar Pujara defends it back towards the bowler.
Fuller again outside off turning it away, Cheteshwar Pujara moves forward and blocks it with his pads.
Fuller and on off, Shubman Gill moves forward and defends it to mid off and scampers through for a single.
Another one down leg, Shubman Gill looks to flick it but gets a rap on his pads. A stifled appeal turned down.
Slightly shorter and on leg, Shubman Gill flicks it but finds the man at short mid-wicket.
This was similar to the last delivery, Cheteshwar Pujara defends it back towards the bowler again.
Flatter and on the pads as Cheteshwar Pujara defends it back towards the bowler.
This one lands down leg, Cheteshwar Pujara looks to block it but gets a rap on his pads. Dot.
Another one on off, Cheteshwar Pujara covers his line and blocks it away.
Another fuller one and on off, Cheteshwar Pujara defends it forward.
Bowls it on middle and leg, Cheteshwar Pujara lunges and blocks it away.
Bowls it on off, Shubman Gill defends it to the man at mid off.
Another fuller one giving it some air, Shubman Gill uses his feet and blocks it away.
Fuller and on off, Shubman Gill defends it solidly.
Tosses it up here, Gill uses his feet and defends it back to the bowler.
Fuller and on off, Cheteshwar Pujara flicks it to square leg for one.
Cheteshwar Pujara walks in early at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Nicely tossed and on off turning it away, drawing the batter forward. KL Rahul looks to block it off the front foot but gets beaten and gets an outside edge. Nurul Hasan behind the sticks is quick to react to it and takes a sharp catch to his right. Shakib Al Hasan is delighted as India lose their skipper for another low score. Bangladesh have an early and a much needed breakthrough in the chase!
Commentary.Howout: c Nurul Hasan b Shakib Al Hasan

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller again, on off. Shubman Gill defends it solidly.
Fuller and on middle, KL Rahul tucks it to mid-wicket for one.
Turns it in from outside off, KL Rahul eases it to mid off.
Fuller and on middle, this is defended towards short covers.
Turn and bounce that beats the outside edge and goes through to the keeper.
Fuller on the stumps, Rahul defends it back to the bowler.
Taijul Islam to operate from the other end.

Did that go to hand? Slightly shorter and on leg, KL Rahul tucks it to the right of the man at short leg and Mominul Haque fails to react quickly. Rahul picks up a single and it is a big opportunity missed for Bangladesh.
Another fuller one and on off, Shubman Gill flicks it to square leg for one. He gets off the mark!
Bowls it on off, Shubman Gill lunges and defends it to the man at mid off.
This one lands outside off, Shubman Gill lunges and blocks it away.
Fuller and on off, Shubman Gill defends it solidly to mid off.

Shakib Al Hasan starts right on the money and almost gets a wicket off the very first delivery! Fuller and on middle and leg, Shubman Gill looks to block it but misses and gets a rap on his pads. A loud appeal turned and Shakib Al Hasan straightaway goes for a review. Ball Tracking shows that it was just missing leg and the onfield decision stands NOT OUT and Bangladesh lose a review as well! Shubman Gill breathes a sigh of relief.
